correctness.rationale: For all N>=5 and 3<=k<=N, the token-graph configurations containing adjacent occupied sites form a zero-forcing set. Induct on minimum cyclic gap d; fixing a nonempty S of k-2 sites, B_t=S+{t,t+d-1} has only possible not-yet-blue neighbors A_t and A_(t-1). The absent A_s for s in S anchors a finite cyclic forcing sweep. The eigenvector consequence follows from H_(B,A) != 0 along every force; the pair-loss kernels set all initial amplitudes to zero. Independently reconstructed token-graph forcing for 39 (N,k) tests, N=5..14 and k<=6; two-particle exclusions checked. The all-N conclusion rests on the induction, not enumeration.
